::: {#exm-membership-inference}

#### Attacks on machine learning services

@shokri2017membership [section I] ran [membership inference attack](#def-membership-inference)s
on classifiers trained by Google's and Amazon's [machine learning](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/course-overview.html#def-machine-learning) services,
which do not reveal the models they train.
Against those models,
their attacks guessed membership with a median [accuracy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/metrics.html#def-accuracy) of 94% and 74%.
On a data set of hospital stays in Texas,
where knowing that a record was in the [training set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-training-set) is itself sensitive,
their attack was right over 70% of the time.

:::
